Type: six-drawer dresser on metal base
Use: storing clothes; bedroom, living room
Style: industrial, mid-century modern, rustic
Materials: solid pine with rough-sawn texture, black steel frame base, recessed finger pulls
Colors: warm reddish brown wood, black
Shape: long rectangular case on open black steel frame, six drawers with slim top-edge pulls, raised and open below
Feel: warm, raw, modern
Goes with: concrete, black metal, white walls; industrial loft bedrooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Mid-Century Stark 6-Drawer Dresser, 61"W, Warm Espresso
product.description: This warm espresso-finished dresser sits on a metal base for a bit of industrial style. The simple metal handles add just the right touch to the minimalist profile. Durable solid pine is built to last and sustainably sourced. 61"W x 18"D x 32"H FSC-certified solid pine. Drawers feature wood runners and safety stops. Mid-century modern design will blend with a modern bedroom. Six large drawers offer lots of storage for clothes. Assemble in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
